riddle.en: I have no mouth but I drink oil, I have no feet but I chase the dark. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Munh nahi par tel peeta hoon, pair nahi par andhera bhagaata hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I follow you all day, but disappear at night. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Din bhar tumhare peeche chalti hoon, raat ko gaayab. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have many layers and I make you cry, yet everyone wants me in the kitchen. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Meri kai parat hain, main rulaata hoon, phir bhi rasoi mein sabko chahiye. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I wear a crown and dance in the rain, my feathers have eyes. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Sir par mukut, baarish mein naachta hoon, mere pankhon mein aankhein hain. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I am round and made of clay. In summer I keep water cool. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Gol hoon, mitti ka bana hoon. Garmi mein paani thanda rakhta hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I grow fat and thin every month, but I never eat. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Har mahine mota-patla hota hoon, par kabhi khaata nahi. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I open when it rains and close when it stops. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Baarish mein khulta hoon, rukte hi band. Main kaun?

riddle.en: Hard outside, soft white inside, with sweet water hidden in me. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Bahar se sakht, andar safed aur naram, mere andar meetha paani chhupa hai. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I give milk, I say 'moo', and Gopal loved me. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Doodh deti hoon, 'baa' bolti hoon, Gopal ki pyaari hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I can be broken without being touched with a hammer, just by saying a word. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Bina chhooye, sirf ek shabd bolne se toot jaata hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have hands but cannot clap, a face but cannot smile. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Haath hain par taali nahi bajaati, chehra hai par muskuraati nahi. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I wake up the whole village but I never use an alarm. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Poore gaon ko jagaata hoon par alarm nahi lagaata. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I eat wood and give you roti. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Lakdi khaata hoon aur tumhe roti deta hoon. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I appear after rain with seven colours, but you can never touch me. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Baarish ke baad saat rangon mein aata hoon, par mujhe koi chhoo nahi sakta. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I am not here yet, but already everyone loves me. Who am I?
riddle.hinglish: Abhi aaya nahi, par sab mujhse pyaar karte hain. Main kaun?

riddle.en: I have one eye but cannot see, I help you sew. What am I?
riddle.hinglish: Ek aankh hai par dekh nahi sakti, silaai mein madad karti hoon. Main kaun?
